scope: Generation quality on public SQuAD 1.1 dev questions with human reference answers, full 2,067-passage corpus, recursive hybrid + neural-reranked retrieval, Qwen3 4B-Instruct (Q4_K_M) via private Ollama on CPU. Not a domain certification.

method.development_set: seed 42, 200 questions; used to diagnose failures and tune the gate/prompt
method.held_out_set: seed 7, 200 questions, zero overlap with the development set; never inspected before the final run
method.correctness: Delivered answers containing a normalized reference span count as correct. Every delivered answer without a span match was reviewed individually against the references and question by the AI assistant (Claude) that built the system; this is a single, non-independent reviewer, so treat adjudication as indicative.
method.strict_policy_counterfactual: Each run also records whether the previous policy (all claims must pass the fast verifier; no escalation, no partial delivery) would have accepted the same answer, isolating the gate change from prompt and sampling differences.

development_improved.policy: abstention fix + escalation + partial delivery + prompt v1

development_baseline_wrong: question periods in the debating chamber
development_improved_wrong: question periods in the debating chamber
held_out_wrong: Rhine join in the direction of its flow
Switzerland border formed by the Rhine
German general and fighter pilot of Huguenot ancestry
modern city on the original Huguenot colony
what justifies us according to Luther

findings: Wrong delivered answers are almost all grounded in a retrieved passage but answer a different reading of a context-dependent question (SQuAD questions were written for one passage, e.g. 'the stadium the teams played in'). The NLI gate verifies support, not that the answer addresses the intended question.
The largest loss is model refusal despite retrieving the gold passage (11.5% held-out); the 4B model is conservative under strict grounding instructions.
Escalation to the stronger NLI model and partial delivery added 14 held-out answers, 13 correct, at ~0.16 s per escalated premise.
The 4B model as its own judge was unreliable in probes (accepted an unstated date, rejected a correct paraphrase) and is not used.
